cs.t: My most useful watch for daily life and my job (pilot) has been a Citizen Navihawk JY8035. I have many styles between the Apple Watch and a Garmin Fenix to a 5$ Casio. The functionality is amazing both day and night. Features I wanted: Automatic time updates to the second Analog face Digital second readout Solar Visible at night Secondary time without any button presses (I use UTC) I list it because it is the best designed watch I’ve used. I’d use it over a breitling any day for functionality. However I would gladly give up one of those circular dials for a date readout. It takes one rotation to switch between the secondary time and the date currently.  https://www.amazon.com/Citizen-Eco-Drive-Navihawk-Timekeepin...  (Deal of the day..)
